description: The p-adic valuation v_p(n): how many times the prime p divides n. v_2(12) is 2, v_3(12) is 1, and v_5(12) is 0. p must be prime. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: p, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/padic
